title: First principles unveiling the metallic TaS2/GeC heterostructure as an anode material in sodium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16484-16492
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01320H, Paper

In this work, we designed the metal/semiconductor TaS2/GeC heterostructure and explored its structural, electronic properties and adsorption performance using first-principles prediction.
